title: foundation-platform dataset group definition
description: Root ADR-0415: every fact of one group of datasets, once. A section's items keep the field set of the artifact they generate (named per section below); that artifact's own schema and checks (orchestration/dags/job_specs.py, scripts/catalog/pipeline_graph.py, scripts/schema_registry.py, the host memory guard) judge them. Generated by definitions/declared.py: the pipeline-graph edge id, job-dependencies.v1.json and docs/data-pipeline-map.md.

group.description: The file's name without .definition.json; the Dagster asset group its assets join.

assets.description: Pipeline-graph nodes (docs/catalog/pipeline-graph.v1.json `nodes`): each id is a Dagster asset key.

dependencies.description: Pipeline-graph edges (`edges`) without their id, which is `<from>-to-<to>`: a Dagster asset's deps.

jobs.description: Scheduled jobs (orchestration/jobs.v1.json `jobs`): what materializes the assets, run as its systemd unit.

host_memory.description: Containers a job's runs take (tools/host-memory-budget.contract.json `scheduled_jobs.memory`), keyed by job id.
